name: Toso Paints
description: Toso Paints is a calm, photographic WordPress store theme crafted for bespoke paint and wallpaper shops with dedicated mixing counters. Designed with an asymmetric three-column hero, fine room-elevation hairlines, and structured stock catalogue tables, it presents products and trade services with deliberate restraint. Built for block editing with full WooCommerce support, the theme performs seamlessly with or without an active storefront.

fonts.role: display: wordmark, headings, labels, navigation, marquee (variable 400-700, Latin subset)

summary.en: A paint and wallpaper shop: three equal photo columns with a room-elevation line drawing, a ruled statement band, round-thumbnail range strip, sticky full-bleed chapters and a stock-list table.

store.withoutPlugin: The Ranges page lists the six paint and paper lines with prices as plain text and orders go by email; the store templates are not used.
